data.source: SYNTHETIC (expengine.simulate, seeded); no public user-level experiment data with known ground truth

E01.name: Onboarding checklist
E01.hypothesis: A guided checklist raises engagement, mostly for new users.
E01.decision: SHIP: significant lift on the primary metric (always-valid p < 0.05), no guardrail harm.

E02.name: Annual-plan upsell banner
E02.hypothesis: Showing the annual plan raises basket size.
E02.decision: SHIP: significant lift on the primary metric (always-valid p < 0.05), no guardrail harm.

E03.name: Button colour (A/A)
E03.hypothesis: No change: an A/A test that should find nothing.
E03.decision: NO DETECTABLE EFFECT at alpha = 0.05 (always-valid). Do not ship on this evidence.

E04.name: Feed redesign
E04.hypothesis: A new feed lifts sessions; much of it is novelty that fades.
E04.decision: SHIP WITH CAUTION: significant lift, but it decays (novelty). Plan on the late-window lift.

E05.name: Checkout v2 (logging bug)
E05.hypothesis: Checkout v2 has no real effect; a tracking bug drops low-engagement treatment users.
E05.decision: INVALID: sample-ratio mismatch. Do not read the metrics; fix assignment/logging and rerun.

E06.name: Trial-reminder email
E06.hypothesis: A reminder email gives a small lift to purchase probability.
E06.decision: SHIP: significant lift on the primary metric (always-valid p < 0.05), no guardrail harm.
